task_definition.instruction_en: In a fixed robotic workspace, generate a rigid, physically consistent embodied robotic arm. The arm maintains high stability with no deformation and enters the frame to Lift the ceramic bowl with earthy brown trim, stack it precisely on top of the bowl with brown outer rim.
task_definition.instruction_zh: 在固定的机器人工作空间中，生成刚性的、物理一致的具体机器人手臂。手臂保持高度稳定性，不变形，进入框架将土棕色镶边的陶瓷碗抬起，精确地堆叠在棕色外缘的碗的顶部。
